title: Southbreak Shore
wikitext:
[[Image:Southbreak Shore.jpg|thumb|Southbreak Shore]]
'''Southbreak Shore''' in [[Tanaris]] is an expanse of flat beach to the south of [[Lost Rigger Cove]].  It is quiet and almost deserted apart from the [[Snapjaw]] turtles crawling in the surf.
